Name: Conduit Sweep
Description: You have spent years crawling through the city's toxic pipe-networks and high-altitude flues, learning how industrial machinery breathes, jams, and vents.

Name: Disgraced Scry-Clerk
Description: You once stamped official manifests in municipal offices, learning the ins and outs of bureaucratic protocol, forged permits, and guard regulations.

Name: Under-Sump Mechanist
Description: You keep the black-market tools, makeshift locks, and patched mechanical implants running in the forgotten underbelly of the city.

Name: Heretical Archivist
Description: You have studied forbidden texts and precursor scripts, granting you an intuitive grasp of arcane circuits and reality-warping phenomena.
